title: The Saturn V Rocket Burned 13 Tons of Fuel Every Second

scenes.text: The Saturn V rocket burned 13 tons of fuel every second.
Five giant engines roared at once to lift it off the pad.
Together they made over seven million pounds of thrust.
The first stage held 4.7 million pounds of fuel and oxygen.
scenes.keywords: saturn v rocket standing launch pad

scenes.text: And it emptied them in just 162 seconds.
Nearly three minutes. A whole stage. Gone.

description:
The Saturn V first stage burned about 13 tons of kerosene and liquid oxygen every second through five F-1 engines.
It made about 7.5 million pounds of thrust at liftoff and used up around 4.7 million pounds of propellant in roughly 162 seconds.
Would you want to watch a launch in person?
first_comment: Bonus: the center engine shut off early so astronauts wouldn't feel too much acceleration. Would you ride one?
